phase_prompt.summary: Dormant chamber with faint glyphs and inert obelisk.
phase_prompt.prompt_block: A photorealistic, cinematic rendering of a dormant subterranean basalt chamber, 30 meters high and 50 meters in diameter, walls etched with faint hieroglyphic glyphs, a 12-meter quartz obelisk at the center with inert crystal nodes, and dark bioluminescent moss on the polished obsidian floor. The chamber is dim, with a low ambient temperature and a subtle, cool glow from the stone.
